title: Tail
text: “It wasn’t exactly a mine with high-quality ore, was it?”

When I went to the mine with my letter of introduction in hand, a miner showed me around the cave. I swapped my spear for a pickaxe and went at the wall with all my might. I was surprised at how easily it crumbled.

With a series of thuds—I’d probably dug a little too deep—the miners were working hard to clear out the dirt. Thanks to that effort, I was able to get my hands on quite a few decent-quality ore samples from this mine. I asked Yuki-chan and Kou to load them onto the wagons, but… did I overload them? The second wagon is slightly warped and creaking as we go.
“Well then, I’ll get started on polishing and all that.”

With the equipment Father bought for me in hand, I began working on cutting and shaping the gems. Thanks to my Weapons skill, I can achieve above-average results at anything, so unless something extraordinary happens, there shouldn’t be any problems.

Carving gems with drill-like tools is incredibly fiddly work. Since simply making them isn’t very interesting, I’m creating various designs with the Filolial-sama in mind—things that would suit them well.
Practice comes first, after all. My future Father deserves praise for enjoying this kind of detailed work.
“It’s so sparkly and beautiful!”
“So pretty!”

Yuki-chan and Kou’s eyes are sparkling. Filolial-sama loves anything that sparkles. Come to think of it, collecting beautiful things like this is a great way to show my gratitude to them. I remember how Filo-tan used to boast about all sorts of things to her Finacée, calling them her “treasures.”
“Hey, hey, Kitamura, can Kou have this?”
Kou wanted the piece of jewelry I made.
“If Father says it’s okay, then it’s fine.”
“Ah, that’s so unfair. Yuki wants one too.”
“No fighting. If you ask Father, I’m sure he’ll let you have it.”
“I’ll give it a try!”
Making jewelry has really started to become fun. Come to think of it, it’s the perfect gift for Filo-tan. I doubt Filo-tan would dislike jewelry either.

From my past memories, those pigs loved shiny things too—though they probably liked them more for their monetary value. Filolial-sama simply love anything that sparkles. You could say that even if it were just Trash ore, as long as it sparkled, they’d treasure it. I think Filo-tan was much the same.
That’s what makes her so adorable. With thoughts like that in mind, I kept making jewelry while the Lazy Pig was busy selling goods as a peddler.

It’s been about a week since I took on an Assistant. Next, we’re touring the western part of the country. I hear that food shortages are starting to surface to some extent not only in Melromarc but also in neighboring countries.

I’ve heard that the Lazy Pig’s territory is becoming quite prosperous. Also, the village in the southwest is reportedly turning into a dense jungle—one I’ve seen in the future. When we first arrived, my father turned pale, worried he’d failed to make the right arrangements. Then, one night while we were casually camping…
“Gau!”
The Assistant’s monster has been growing larger by the minute due to leveling up. According to my father, it’s already at Level 55. I’m told the Assistant has also already completed a Class Up.

Apparently, the plan now is to focus on various ways to boost its latent abilities through enhancement methods. Seeing the assistant and the monster growing day by day, Filolial-sama is working hard not to be outdone. She’s putting even more effort into her job pulling the carriage. As expected of my Father—he must have anticipated this when he recruited them as companions.
Oh, and I hear the accessories I made are selling for a decent price. Though, I have no idea how to perform the ability imbuing my Father used to do. How is it done, I wonder?

Apparently, when he asked the Lazy Pig, he was told it’s a specialized skill, so he’d have to ask someone else. Fortunately, it seems the Lazy Pig knows someone who’s knowledgeable about it, so he’ll be able to get some information soon.
“Still… the fact that everyone except the Hero is capped at Level 100 is a real pain, isn’t it…”
“Yeah, you’re right.”
My father muttered as he checked the Assistant’s stats.
“Hey, in the future, was this the only way to boost abilities?”
“No, my Father in the future had discovered a way to perform a Class Up beyond the Level 100 cap.”
“Really? How did he do it? We might need to know that down the line, don’t you think?”
“Um… I believe it had something to do with the dragon the Assistant was raising.”
“So a dragon is involved in breaking through the limit? In that case, don’t we need a dragon either way?”
“It’s a hard fact to believe, you know.”
Come to think of it, breaking through the limit is essential for raising a powerful Filolial-sama. After all, there are certain stats that only appear when strengthening beyond level 100.
“Gau!”
“Heh heh! Dragons are necessary in this world, you know.”
The Assistant is proudly taunting Sakura-chan and the others. “Don’t get too cocky!”
“Booh!”
Sakura-chan and the others replied with a look of frustration. I’ll join everyone in booing, too. How can we make her pay for this infuriating attitude?
“Wyndia-chan, try to keep it in check. You don’t actually hate Sakura-chan and the others, do you?”
The Assistant nodded silently.
“Birds aren’t going to lose to dragons!”
She seems to be taunting me, though.
“All right, all right, get along.”
Father patted the assistant and Sakura-chan lightly on the shoulder to calm them down.
“How’s it going? Are you getting used to it a little?”
“…Yeah.”

Even I can tell the assistant is perking up more than before. Sometimes she’s playing happily with Filolial-sama. On the other hand, there were times when the assistant’s monster was playfully roughhousing with Father.
“Gyaaaah!”
Suddenly, Keel’s scream rang out. When I looked over, I saw that Kou was gently nibbling on Keel’s tail. Keel, left hanging in midair, screamed and slammed his fist into Kou.
“Keel! Kou!”
“Let go! How long are you going to keep chewing on someone’s tail?!”
“Mmm… Keel-kun’s tail—”
“Let Keel go!”

After getting kicked by Luna-chan, Kou opened his beak and let Keel drop to the ground with a plop. Keel immediately ran over to my Father, using Luna-chan and my Father as a shield as he glared at Kou.
“Are you still picking on me?! Give it a rest already!”
“I’m just licking, just licking—it’s so hard to resist when he’s wiggling around like that!”
“Kou… could you please stop going after Keel-kun already?”
Father admonished Kou with a troubled look.
“Yeah, Sakura thinks so too. He’s wiggling around, but he’s not really something you should be going after, is he?”
“Eh? But Kou… I think about it all day long! He looks so plump and delicious…”
“Listen, Kou. Keel-kun isn’t your dinner, okay?”
“That’s right. Even though Keel-kun is cute and fluffy, we have to take good care of him.”
“Yeah, Keel-kun is cute. He’s something to admire.”
“I think he’s cool!”
“Things get complicated when Sakura-chan and Luna-chan join the conversation, so please stay quiet. Right now, we need to give Kou a lecture.”
“Luna will protect Keel-kun.”
“Whoa! Stop being so fluffy! Don’t bury me in your chest—whoa… feathers! I’m getting buried in feathers! I’m being trapped by soft feathers!?”
My father sighs as he watches the back-and-forth between Luna-chan and Keel.
“Luna, I know you want to take good care of Keel, but that’s no different from what Kou does.”
“Oh, right. Then I’ll stop. Luna doesn’t want Keel to have a hard time…”
With a plop, Keel is scooped up by Luna.
“Ugh… My whole body’s crackling.”
“That static electricity looks intense.”
After muttering that, my Father turns his gaze toward Kou.

“Kou… We’re well into the journey now, and I think everyone’s gotten used to it, but how long will it take for you to learn that Keel-kun isn’t food? At first, I thought you were joking, but it’s become pretty obvious lately, hasn’t it?”
“He’s gotten all plump and looks so delicious now—”
“Well… his coat has definitely gotten shinier. But how many times do I have to tell you not to eat him before you get it?”
“Boo!”
Father’s smile froze as Kou protested.
“Kou? Give it a rest already. You should be eating the meal Lord Naofumi has prepared with more dignity.”
Yuki-chan tried to scold him, but Kou just brushed it off.
“Well then, Iwatani, I want to eat Keel-kun with the sauce you made.”
“Don’t mess with me! What kind of sauce is that?!”
“Kou… if you don’t cut it out, I’m going to get mad, too.”
“I’m not scared even if Iwatani gets mad—I mean, he’s not scary at all.”
“Hey, big bro! He’s totally taking you for granted.”
At Kou’s reply, my Father’s expression turned slightly displeased.
